svg.text: Global coprimality bridge - independent review
31 October 2026
Result
Five global-to-local polynomial lemmas passed fresh compilation and axiom readback. Producer controls and
additional reviewer characteristic-two and common-root controls passed. No blocking discrepancy was identified
at this scope.
Exact premise and derivation
IsCoprime f f.derivative means an explicit polynomial Bezout identity A*f+B*f' = 1. Evaluating at a putative
common zero gives 0=1. For the retained monic quintic, evaluation and formal derivative evaluation equal the
previously defined value and derivative expressions. Applying this exclusion to the reviewed same-support
extraction proves its normalized ordinate is nonzero from the original two divisibility premises, nonzero slope
difference and noninverse condition.
Characteristic boundaries
The proof works over an arbitrary field and never divides by 5. Producer F5 controls cover X^5-X with derivative
-1 and the rejected X^5 example. Reviewer F2 control supplies f=X^5+X+1 and the certificate f-X*f'=1; a rational
X^2 common-zero control rejects coprimality. These are polynomial assertions. They do not identify geometric
smoothness of y^2=f in characteristic two. The downstream weighted doubling composition still needs its separate
characteristic-not-two and nonzero-weight premises.
Custody and independent checks
231 recorded source, producer and dependency-cache bindings were rechecked. The copied theorem module, five
producer controls and five-declaration axiom readback all exited 0. Only propext, Classical.choice and
Quot.sound appeared. Additional reviewer controls exited 0 after a retained numeral-normalization failure. The
retained dependency objects were hash checked, not rebuilt transitively.
Failures retained
Producer missing-import, namespace and numeral-control failures remain in its sealed packet; its second main
attempt recorded process exit -9. Reviewer attempt 1 failed to reduce the coefficient 4 in F2; attempt 2 added
that explicit reduction and passed. Successful reviewer output retains unused-simp/tactic warnings.
Review authorship and exclusions
The reviewer authored imported extraction and doubling components and had reviewed the local bridge; this review
is independent of the new global-bridge construction. No Squarefree/Separable equivalence, global certificate-
finding algorithm, UInt64 execution, class-sum, compiler, operation-count or scientific timing result is
asserted. No scientific trial was run. Full-cohort cost ratio is null.
